text:
nina: quick flag: onboarding example (node) sometimes loses X-Request-Id on retry after auth refresh. only reproducible when LOG_LEVEL=debug is enabled in the container.

arjun: can you share the minimal steps? which example dir/version?

nina: examples/onboard/node @ v0.4.2. steps: start container with LOG_LEVEL=debug and OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=true, call /generate with a short-lived token -> triggers 401 -> client refresh -> retry. initial attempt shows X-Request-Id in logs, retry's log lines are missing it.

maya: paste of the relevant logs: ```
[info] incoming: POST /generate id=4a2c
[debug] auth: token refresh start
[debug] auth: token refresh ok
[info] retrying request
[info] outgoing: status=200
```
(note: no id= on the retry line)

tiago: are we attaching the header at express middleware or in SDK outgoing hook?

nina: express attachReqId middleware. code does: req.id = gen(); res.setHeader('X-Request-Id', req.id); next(); then downstream call to client.generate(). when auth refresh happens, the refresh code constructs a new http request; looks like header propagation to that new request is skipped when OTEL wraps fetch.

gwen: this rings a bell. earlier auto-instrumentation wrapped node/core http and we had a bug where header cloning didn't happen on re-created requests. fixed in auto-instrumentation 0.9.7.

maya: reproduced locally: pin auto-instrumentation to 0.9.5 -> failure, bump to 0.9.7 -> header persists across refresh.

ci-bot: opened PR #53 to add a targeted integration test (linux-only) asserting X-Request-Id carried through auth-refresh retry. CI matrix: linux passes, mac flakey.

arjun: add a test that runs without OTEL auto-instrumentation and with it, so we catch regressions both ways. also ensure we run integration on linux workers only to avoid mac flakiness.

nina: will update PR. I'll also add a one-line change to the onboarding Dockerfile to bump auto-instrumentation to >=0.9.7, and a note in the quickstart docs: "If you enable OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT, ensure auto-instrumentation >=0.9.7 to avoid X-Request-Id loss during SDK auth/retry flows."

tiago: can we add a short e2e in the dedicated images build pipeline so new dedicated customers don't hit this?

maya: good idea, I'll add it to the dedicated example image build step.

arjun: thanks. let's also add a small troubleshooting FAQ blurb for support:
- symptom: missing X-Request-Id on retried requests in debug logs
- cause: OTEL auto-instrumentation <0.9.7 wrapping request creation and skipping header copy during auth-retry
- quick fix: set OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=false or bump auto-instrumentation to >=0.9.7

nina: PR updated to include linux-only test, Dockerfile bump, and docs note. CI passing on linux. marking this resolved for onboarding examples but keeping thread open for any followups. :thumbsup:
